source: Owner direct chat after discussing post-death bullet interaction and current Epic Physics Control examples
owner_message_original: Давай тогда попробуем как эксперемент создать вторую куклу Physics Control, создай план на это и задачи или задачу.
owner_message_english_translation: Let's then try creating a second Physics Control dummy as an experiment; create a plan and tasks or a task for it.
decision: Prepare one bounded experimental task and its implementation plan for a second Physics Control mannequin alongside the retained enemy prototype.
owner_intent: Explore Physics Control on a second dummy before deciding whether to adopt it for the existing enemy.
context: The owner wants a dying/dead body to retain ragdoll collision and respond physically to further bullets, particularly during slow motion. Epic's powered-ragdoll example was discussed as a potential reference.
controller_planning_choices: Use one task with sequential implementation, focused verification and one primary independent review.
Use an existing Manny as a removable second stationary fixture and preserve the original enemy for comparison.
Cover powered living hits, a single transition to passive ragdoll, falling/resting corpse impacts, sleep/wake and reset.
Include a bounded coherent body-and-bullet slow-motion development preview; retain the full player-facing time ability in MSQ-75.
Keep this experimental child unstaged; do not reorder or dispatch the existing MSQ-70-and-later sequence.
adoption: The experiment does not approve replacement of the baseline enemy, final enemy art or full Euphoria-style behavior.
preservation: Keep owner edits, retained lobby, PurchasedArms06, MSQ-69/MSQ-82 evidence, original sources and paused art/environment work. No purchases or new model production.
